tools.description: The game, the loaded bundle's provenance (or why none is loaded), the stat-description scopes, and every economy snapshot (league, poe.ninja league ID, as_of, patch, verification, status) with the files skipped and why. Call first. Every result carries `provenance`: game, patch, Steam build, the bundle's manifest SHA-256 and index SHA-256, and whether it is signed by a trusted key. Read-only.
tools.name: get_snapshot_info
tools.title: What data is loaded

tools.description: Mod rows matching every filter given: `text` in the mod ID, affix name, or game text; part of a `stat` ID; a spawn or implicit `tag`; `domain`; `generation`. Each mod: ID, affix name, level, domain, generation, stats with ranges (stat IDs, ADR-015), the game text, spawn tags. At most `limit` (default 25, at most 100), with the total. Every result carries `provenance`: game, patch, Steam build, the bundle's manifest SHA-256 and index SHA-256, and whether it is signed by a trusted key. Read-only.
tools.name: search_mods
tools.title: Search mods

tools.description: A skill or support gem by name: tags, attribute split, its granted effect (support or not, cast time, skill types, quality stats) and, per level asked (`levels`, default [1, 20]; [] for all), costs, cooldown, reservation, and stat-set values (stat IDs). Every result carries `provenance`: game, patch, Steam build, the bundle's manifest SHA-256 and index SHA-256, and whether it is signed by a trusted key. Read-only.
tools.name: get_gem
tools.title: Get a gem

tools.description: A unique item by name: its ID and flavour text. The game's client data does not list a unique's mods, so `mods` is null; read the item's own lines instead. Every result carries `provenance`: game, patch, Steam build, the bundle's manifest SHA-256 and index SHA-256, and whether it is signed by a trusted key. Read-only.
tools.name: get_unique
tools.title: Get a unique

tools.description: Every base item row with the name: class, tags, drop and required level, attribute requirements, implicits (stat IDs and game text), weapon, armour, or shield properties, and socket caps by item level. Every result carries `provenance`: game, patch, Steam build, the bundle's manifest SHA-256 and index SHA-256, and whether it is signed by a trusted key. Read-only.

name.description: The base's name (or ID), any case.

tools.name: get_base
tools.title: Get an item base

tools.description: Passive nodes by `name` (every node with it) or by `node` ID, one of the two: kind (small, notable, keystone, mastery, jewel socket, ascendancy start), ascendancy, stats (stat IDs) and game text, a mastery's effects, flavour text. Every result carries `provenance`: game, patch, Steam build, the bundle's manifest SHA-256 and index SHA-256, and whether it is signed by a trusted key. Read-only.
tools.name: get_passive
tools.title: Get a passive

tools.description: Item, passive, or gem text to (stat ID, value) through the stat descriptions (Spike B's resolver): each line or multi-line template, its outcome (resolved, ambiguous, unresolved, with the reason), every candidate's stats, and shadowed matches. Unresolved text is returned as unresolved, never dropped (ADR-015). `scope`: item (default), passive, gem, or a stat-description file name. Every result carries `provenance`: game, patch, Steam build, the bundle's manifest SHA-256 and index SHA-256, and whether it is signed by a trusted key. Read-only.
tools.name: resolve_stat
tools.title: Resolve text to stat IDs

tools.description: An item's or currency's price from the newest economy snapshot of the league (`league`: name or poe.ninja ID; default the newest current league), optionally narrowed by `variant` and `links`: chaos and divine values, volume or listings, with the snapshot's league, as_of, fetched time, patch, verification, and `signed: false`. Refuses another game's snapshots, never falls back to another league, and refuses when the loaded bundle's patch is unknown (not in the patch table); a patch mismatch is a warning. Only listed fields of a snapshot row are returned. State `as_of` and the league when quoting a price. Read-only; no network.
tools.name: get_price
tools.title: Get a price
